concept: S3 + CloudFront + ACM: serverless static website
tests: Choosing the cheapest architecture to serve a static SPA globally over HTTPS without servers.
expected: S3 (static hosting / origin with OAC) + a CloudFront distribution + an ACM certificate — global, low latency, HTTPS, pennies. Triggers: "static single-page app", "globally", "HTTPS", "lowest cost", "without running servers".
why_not: EC2+ALB and ECS Fargate — servers and more expensive; Lambda per request — unnecessary compute and latency for static content.
